sections.title: charaNam 1
lyrics: jaya janArdhana krishna rAdhika pathe - jana vimochana krishna janma mochana
garuda vAhana krishna gopika pathE - nayana mohana krishna neerajeekshana
sujana bAndhava krishna sundharakruthe - madhana komala mrishna mAdhava hari
vasumathi pathe krishna vAsavanuja - varaguNAkara krishna vaishnavAkruthe

sections.title: charaNam 2
lyrics: suruchirAnana krishNa shouryavAridhe - murahara vibho krishNa mukthi dhAyaka
vimala pAlaka krishNa vallabhi pathe - kamala lochana krishNa kamyadhAyaka
vimalagAthrane krishNa bhakthavathsala - charana pallavam krishNa karuna komalam
kuvala eekshaNa krishNa komalAkruthe - thava padhambujam krishNa sharaNamAshraye

sections.title: charaNam 3
lyrics: bhuvana nAyaka krishNa pAvanakruthe - guNaganojwala krishNa naliNalochana
pranayavAridhe krishNa guNagaNAkara - dhAmasodhara krishNa dheena vathsala
kAmasundhara krishNa pAhi sarvadha - narakanAshana krishNa nara sahAyaka
dhEvaki sutha krishNa kAruNyAmbhudhe - kamsa nAshana krishNa dwarakAsthitha

sections.title: charaNam 4
lyrics: pAvanAthmaka krishNa dhEhi mangalam - thvath padhAmbujam krishNa shyAma komalam
bhaktha vathsala krishNa kAmya dhAyaka - pAlisEnnanu krishNa shrihari namo
bhaktha dhAsa nA krishNa harasu nee sadha - kAdhu ninthenA krishNa salaheya vibho
garuda vAhana krishNa gopika pathe - nayana mohana krishNa neerajekshana
